lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno heard the cat's in the bag,
He rushed to free the little scamp!
Kiki smiled, oh Bruno, relax,
No kitty's hiding in a sack!
[chorus]
Cat out of the bag, cat out of the bag,
The secret's loose, the news is had!
Cat out of the bag, cat out of the bag,
You spilled it all, now that's a laugh!
[verse]
When a secret slips and shows,
And suddenly the whole town knows,
We say the cat is out and free,
The hidden thing's for all to see!
[chorus]
Cat out of the bag, cat out of the bag,
The secret's loose, the news is had!
Cat out of the bag, cat out of the bag,
No tucking back the secret had!
[outro]
So when a secret won't stay snug,
The cat is out, give it a shrug!
